customdrops.menu.title: Custom Drops
customdrops.menu.unsaved.title: Unsaved changes
customdrops.menu.unsaved.message: You have unsaved changes in this config. What do you want to do?
customdrops.config.mobDrops.description: Control what a specific mob (or entity tag) drops when it dies. Each entry can add items on top of (or instead of) its normal drops.
customdrops.config.blockDrops.descriptio: Control what a specific block (or block tag) drops when broken.
customdrops.config.chestLoot.description: Control any loot table by its id - not just chests. Dungeon and village chests, trial chamber vault rewards, suspicious sand and gravel, and more all work here. See the Browse screen for real ids.
customdrops.config.fishingLoot.descripti: Control fishing-specific loot tables (the overall pool, or just the fish, junk, or treasure sub-pools). Works the same way as Chest Loot, kept separate for organization.
customdrops.config.equipment.description: Force a mob's held or worn item to always drop on death, instead of the normal small chance. This does not add new items - it only affects equipment the mob already spawned with.
customdrops.config.wildcard.hint: Tip: end the target with * to match every loot table starting with that prefix (e.g. minecraft:chests/village/*).
customdrops.config.condition.killedByPla: Only when killed by a player
customdrops.config.condition.onFire: Only when target is on fire
customdrops.config.condition.entityOnFir: Only when entity is on fire
customdrops.config.browse: Browse all known loot table ids
customdrops.config.export.desc: Copy the current configuration as a base64 string to share or backup.
customdrops.config.export.copyHint: Select all (Ctrl+A) and copy (Ctrl+C), or use the button below:

customdrops.config.import.invalid: Invalid config data. Could not decode or parse.
customdrops.config.presets.description: Picking a preset replaces every category's entries with that preset's defaults. Leave on 'none' to configure everything yourself.
